Say “Hey Adam, what's the weather in Seattle, Washington?” Replies play on the unit that heard you. Try current weather, today's forecast, or tomorrow's forecast.

WEATHER

Source & replies

No API key needed. City searches and coordinates go to Open-Meteo over the internet. Your recordings, transcripts, and voice generation stay local on your head-end. Weather is cached for up to ten minutes.

The panel shows time and weather with an optional device name. Change device names on Devices & paging. Home supplies local weather and time unless a device has its own location below.

Use your default voice everywhere, or choose a separate voice for information replies.

Changes take effect after saving.

Try a question

Test the saved settings without speaking. Preview shows the answer here; sending plays it on one unit.

Saved locations

Use names such as “home” or “the cabin.” A question without a place uses that device's location, or Home.

Start typing a town, city, state, or country. Choose a suggestion, select it as Home or for a device, then save settings. The location also sets the local time zone. Up to 16 locations.

Supported questions

  • What's the weather? / What's tomorrow's forecast at home?
  • What's the temperature in Seattle? / Will it rain today in Portland, Oregon?
  • What time is it? / What's today's date?
  • What time is it in Tokyo?
  • How many days until Friday? / How many days until Christmas?

Configure switch and sensor questions separately under Home Assistant. Other open-ended questions route to Conversation when enabled.
